Chapter 326: Chapter 20 The Teacher’s Gift (Please Subscribe)

Crimson palace.

Lin Yuan and his twelve senior brothers stood below.

Chikun Starlord, the teacher, sat in the high seat, as Lin Yuan glanced at the other senior brothers.

He noticed that the senior brothers all behaved very casually; Chikun Star Lord wasn’t the type of teacher who was very imposing, preferring a friendly approach with his disciples.

“Everyone has arrived.”

Chikun Star Lord nodded slightly.

...

Actually, there were many Sixth Rank and Seventh Rank Evolvers in the Chikun lineage, but at its core, naturally, the Star Lord and various Peak Masters were the main focus.

Within the Cosmic Human Alliance, the relationship between a teacher and his disciples even surpassed that of the closest kinship.

Once the master-disciple relationship was confirmed, it truly required commitment.

In the past several tens of thousands of years, Chikun Star Lord hadn’t taken any disciples, not only because he hadn’t met any satisfactory Evolvers but also because accepting a disciple wasn’t just a matter of saying so.

If in the future a disciple caused some trouble outside, Chikun Star Lord would have to step in and offer protection.

Those Evolvers who passed the test of Seven Star Cave and joined the Red Kun lineage, strictly speaking, weren’t Chikun Star Lord’s disciples, and they weren’t even disciples of the twelve Peak Masters.

They could only be considered members of the Red Kun lineage.

The Red Kun lineage nurtured them, and in turn, they served the Red Kun lineage; both sides gave to each other.

“I’ll keep it short.”

“You’ve also heard about the commotion caused by the Insect Race on the battlefield.”

“Although our human civilization’s top prophets discovered it in advance and the loss wasn’t substantial, we can’t let this matter slide so easily.”

Chikun Star Lord spoke in a calm tone.

Taking as an example the Battlefield C24763 where Lin Yuan’s Taiyin Primordial Spirit was, the Heiyuan Clan wanted to cleanse the battlefield.

Even though many human Evolvers fled in all directions, there were still numerous Sixth and Seventh Rank Evolvers who died.

This type of loss, compared to the overall war situation, wasn’t significant.

At least the Insect Race’s planning failed, and the gaze of human civilization’s Supreme Beings hadn’t been drawn away by those medium-sized and small-sized otherworldly battlefields.

But how could human civilization tolerate such a loss without reason?

In the over two million years of the Starry Sea Era, human civilization, in the eyes of the Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Sky, differed little from demons.

If you dare to disregard the baseline of warfare and strike with full force, wait for the crazed retaliation of human civilization.

“Eldest brother, you lead the army of Evolvers to Battlefield C34123…”

“Second brother, you lead the army of Evolvers to Battlefield C459543….”

“Third brother…”

…

Chikun Star Lord issued his orders following this pattern.

It wasn’t just the Chikun Star Domain; the entire Annan Star Alliance and many other Star Alliances, one Star Domain after another, began transferring troops and increasing their investment in the battlefields.

Ever since human civilization left its homeworld, there has always been a constant launch of battlefields, but at different times, the intensity and fierceness of the battlefields varied.

For example, before the Insect Race’s action, human civilization actually did not invest much power into the battlefields.

The same was true for the other few peak civilizations; after all these years of fighting, they had formed some kind of tacit understanding.

But now, since the Insect Race actively broke the tacit agreement, human civilization naturally wouldn’t indulge them.

“On the battlefield, all actions should be centered around the Goddess of Freedom.”

Chikun Star Lord said.

Human external expansion and invasion were all coordinated by the Goddess of Freedom.

With the Goddess of Freedom, every bit of human force could be fully utilized; this was the key to human civilization’s successive victories on the battlefield.

“Teacher, what about me?”

Lin Yuan looked at how all twelve senior brothers had assignments and he had been overlooked, so he couldn’t help but ask.

“Come here and take a look; just get familiar with it.”

Chikun Star Lord shook his head and said, his main reason for inviting Lin Yuan over this time was to get him accustomed to the atmosphere of the battlefield.

As for sending Lin Yuan to the battlefield… Chikun Star Lord really couldn’t bear to do it.

Although it’s said that even talented Evolvers need to be tempered on the battlefield, that prerequisite is for when they hit a bottleneck and various attempts to break through have failed, and they have no choice but to make such a reluctant decision.

Given the talent that Lin Yuan had shown, there was no sign he was trapped by any bottlenecks; sending him to a battlefield fraught with danger at this time would be foolish.

“Junior brother, once you cultivate an avatar, you can go to the battlefield,” the eldest senior brother said with a smile.

The twelve senior brothers, including Chikun Star Lord, didn’t know about Lin Yuan’s Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit, which were equivalent to having two ‘avatars.’

The Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit avatars, although not unique, could make one suspect that they were related to the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

…..

“Teacher, what exactly happened on the large battlefield? The mysterious corpse that drifted in from the Eternal Spatial Rift, what’s the situation with that…”

After tasks were assigned, third senior brother asked out of curiosity.

The reason the Insect Race broke the tacit agreement was because of that mysterious corpse.

This corpse also attracted other peak clans’ Supreme Beings who didn’t hesitate to personally intervene, eventually tearing that corpse into pieces.

On Battlefield S111, the presence of the Supreme Beings was overwhelming, and this matter couldn’t be concealed at all.

As a result.

Many people were very curious about that corpse.

A treasure that could provoke a battle amongst several Supreme Beings was extremely rare; at the level of Supreme Beings, every action was an embodiment of the universal truths, with no need for external objects.

“That corpse…”

Chikun Star Lord pondered for a moment.

Seeing this, Lin Yuan also appeared attentive.

The chaotic flows in the void outside the worlds, depending on their intensity, can be divided into different regions.

The chaotic void outside the Immortal Tao World where Lin Yuan had traversed for the fifth time wasn’t too harsh, allowing those with Seventh Rank strength to barely survive.
